usable: yes: same rows, the authors' exact folds (published per-row fold assignments), Reference column (130 papers) so P1 is already paper-grouped and P2 applies. Caveat: unpublished manuscript, not peer-reviewed.

source.work: Huang X., Zheng W., Shi M. (Shanghai Univ. of Engineering Science), DOPO-EP-ML manuscript; code github.com/huangxueling027/DOPO-EP-ML @ e550e4a247d01c837041afd1aa6702f62a8f2ccf (v1.0.2, MIT); data Mendeley doi:10.17632/6wxr5hsd48.1 (CC BY 4.0)
source.provenance: data/sources/incoming/huang_dopo_ep_ml/SOURCE.md (byte-identical Mendeley copy also in data/sources/incoming/dopo_ep_ml/, fetched by another worker)

target: LOI (%), epoxy + DOPO-derived FRs, absolute LOI, 'baseline_inclusive' rows (as the authors)

rows.exclusions: none (all 599 have LOI). 131 rows are neat epoxy (Loading_total_FR wt% == 0); kept with FR-derived features masked, exactly as the authors' row policy.

features.definition: the authors' LOI input: view 'compact', K = 260, descriptor_mode 'basic', V7 formula features on, no BDE, screening_mode 'formulation', feature_scope 'all', neat-EP masking on. Raw matrix from common/scientific_evaluation.py prepare_scientific_bundle('data/DOPO_EP_new.csv') + _filter_task_matrix(bundle, 'LOI', 'compact', use_bde=False, screening_mode='formulation') + the neat-row masking inside evaluate_task_nested. Inside every training fold their front end is fitted: NonEmptyColumnSelector -> SimpleImputer(median) -> DuplicateColumnRemover -> VarianceThreshold(1e-8) -> SafeSelectKBest(f_regression, k=260); c1-c3 replace only their final 'model' step.
features.step0_export (needs owner approval: sepa: a shim run from a clean clone at e550e4a writes, for every fold of P1_pub and of the shared P1/P2 splits, the post-front-end train/test matrices + Record_IDs to experiments/runs/samedata_dopo_folds/*.npz. c1-c3 are then fit in the Dravix env on those matrices. The front end's SelectKBest uses training-fold labels only.
features.why_not_raw_csv: the CSV holds SMILES and formulation fields; the 260 inputs are generated by their RDKit pipeline, so 'same input' means their pipeline.

bar.metric: R2, mean of the 5 per-outer-fold R2 (SD over folds, ddof=1)
bar.set: source-paper (Reference) grouped 5-fold outer CV, nested 5-fold grouped inner CV for model choice
bar.quote_result: results/09_MainTextTables/Table 2 row: "LOI,R²,0.716 ± 0.036,0.708 ± 0.041,0.709 ± 0.084,0.714 ± 0.047,-0.003,0.567" (columns Molecule, Scaffold, Reference, With BDE, ΔMetric, SHAP ρ)
bar.quote_protocol: README: "Values are reported as mean ± standard deviation across the outer test folds of the grouped nested cross-validation procedure."
bar.where_read: repo @ e550e4a: README, results/09_MainTextTables/Table 2, results/scientific_validation/FINAL_grouping_sensitivity_5x5/LOI/reference/.../LOI_nested_summary.json. Recomputed 2026-10-07 from their LOI_outer_predictions.csv: 0.7093 +- 0.0842 (pooled 0.7098).
bar.best_model: inner-CV choice per outer fold among Ridge, RF, ExtraTrees, GBDT, XGB, LGBM, SVR, SoftVote: XGB in 3 folds, GBDT in 2 (reference grouping). Final molecule-grouped bundle: GBDT.
bar.verification: repo code + result tables, recomputed from the authors' per-row predictions. Manuscript text not available (unpublished).
bar.context_always_printed: modified-formulation subset under the same folds: R2 0.419 +- 0.210 (their summary). The overall 0.709 is lifted by the 131 neat-epoxy rows; Dravix's RPUF LOI benchmark has no such rows.
secondary_not_claimed: molecule-grouped (their headline, Table 1): 0.716 +- 0.036 (recomputed 0.7165); run as P1_mol and reported, no claim.
external literature set: R2 -0.21, MAE 2.47, n = 20 (results/10_ExternalValidation/FINAL_fixed/external_validation_metrics.csv); run as P3, reported only.

r0 (reproduction control).r0_full: their evaluate_task_nested(bundle, 'LOI', <tmp>, EvaluationOptions(split_strategy='reference', selection_scope='fixed', row_policy='baseline_inclusive', use_bde=False, outer_splits=5, inner_splits=5, random_state=42)) in the step-0 env. Run on P1_pub only (their nested selection is wired to their own unshuffled folds).
r0 (reproduction control).r0: their front end + GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=220, learning_rate=0.03, max_depth=2, subsample=0.85, random_state=42) (their GBDT, common/scientific_evaluation.py line 519), no inner selection; run on P1_pub, P1, P1_mol and P2 so every candidate has a same-split control.

reproduction_gate: r0_full on P1_pub must give mean per-fold R2 in [0.699, 0.719] (their env, same folds). Outside -> BLOCKED for this dataset (feature construction not reproduced, so 'same input' fails).

protocols.P1_pub: their exact folds: outer_fold by Record_ID from data/sources/incoming/huang_dopo_ep_ml/LOI_outer_predictions_reference.csv (sha256 9b4b8fa4...; equals GroupKFold(5) unshuffled by Reference, 479-480 train / 119-120 test rows). Metric = their aggregation (mean of 5 per-fold R2). r0_full gate + r0; c1-c3 information only.
protocols.P1: GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=r), r = 0..9, groups = Reference; per repeat the mean of the 5 per-fold R2 (their aggregation); report mean, SD, r=0 value. Also the same metric on the modified-only rows (Loading > 0), reported, not selected on.
protocols.P1_mol: as P1 but groups = their 'molecule' labels (Canonical_main_co_pair from their standardisation) and P1_pub_mol folds from LOI_outer_predictions_molecule.csv; bar 0.716. Reported only.
protocols.P2: common P2 on the same splits as P1 (pooled OOF R2 per repeat, repeat-0 paper bootstrap CI over the 130 references).
protocols.P3: fit on all 599, predict the external rows their 10_ExternalValidation input filter keeps (must be n = 20; else report n). R2 and MAE vs their -0.21 / 2.47. Reported only.

notes: P1 and P2 share splits and differ only in aggregation (per-fold mean vs pooled OOF); both are printed.
Each fold holds ~26 references, so per-fold R2 is noisy (their SD 0.084).
c2 sees 260 selected features (TabPFN v2 limit 500).
